observations.behavior: Adds a new state value and its computation, and a conditional UI, to the warehouse source catalog.
observations.code_quote: hasCrossCategoryMatches: (catalogFuse: Fuse, search: string, selectedCategory: SourceCategoryFilter) => boolean
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse users to distinguish between 'no sources found' and 'sources exist but are hidden by category filter', and offer a 'Search all categories' option instead of a dead-end. This could reduce user confusion and help them discover available warehouse sources.
